name: agent_landing_benchmark_v2
purpose: Evaluate model capability under agent-era harness conditions, including memory, tools, long-running workflows, context strategy, governance, and system readability.

families.description: Multi-turn preference retention, memory extraction, and history compression.
Evidence collection, state updates, process completion, and grounded decisions.
Tool selection, tool failure handling, retry, fallback, and hallucination resistance.
Repository navigation, mutation, test execution, and executable verification.
Planner/generator/evaluator loops, sprint contracts, handoffs, resume, and verifier feedback.
Map-vs-manual instructions, compaction, reset, micro-compaction, and context pressure.
Role separation, handoff quality, conflict resolution, and integration planning.
Permissions, sandboxing, hooks, audit trails, observability, and policy constraints.
